slides.title: The Merchant's Scale
slides.visual_hint: A balance scale with 2 blue gems on the left and 3 amber gems on the right.
slides.narration: A ratio is a relationship comparing two amounts. Here, for every two blue gems, we need three amber gems.

slides.title: Scaling the Magic
slides.visual_hint: Two pouches appearing beside each pile.
slides.narration: What if we need a larger batch? We must scale both amounts by the same multiplier.

slides.title: Avoid the Addition Trap
slides.visual_hint: A warning rune glowing red over a '+1' icon.
slides.narration: Never add a number to both sides. Ratios scale by multiplication, not addition!

slides.title: Multiplying in Harmony
slides.visual_hint: 2 times 3 becomes 6 gems; 3 times 3 becomes 9 gems.
slides.narration: Multiplying both sides by three yields six blue gems to nine amber gems. The balance holds!

slides.title: Simplifying Back
slides.visual_hint: Dividing 6 and 9 by 3 to return to 2:3.
slides.narration: Dividing both terms by their common factor brings us right back to simplest form: two to three.

slides.title: Proportion Mastery
slides.visual_hint: A glowing heraldic crest of the merchant guild.
slides.narration: Keep your ratios balanced and your trades will always be true. Well done, scholar!
